purpose: Handbook page about the avatar, the shop and the wardrobe.
details: Explains that every child has a pixel avatar that is also the practice buddy, how points buy parts, that each purchase asks a calculation (with discounts from year 5), what happens when a purchase answer is wrong (package on its way or shipping costs, parent setting), and how the wardrobe and saved combinations work.
summary: Describes Mijn avatar: the avatar as buddy, the shop with layers (shape, colour, eyes, ears, hair, hats, accessories), buying with a calculation question (discounts from the 5th year), delivery penalties after wrong answers, and the wardrobe with saved outfits.
